title: Visiting craft villages in the suburbs of Hanoi

html:
Located about 25km from Hanoi, visitors will visit many traditional craft villages, with many unique products that represent the unique culture of the countryside. So let’s go with Vietlook travel to review the craft villages in the suburbs of Hanoi in this article.

Thach Xa village makes bamboo dragonflies

Located right at the foot of Tay Phuong mountain where Tay Phuong Thach That pagoda is located, from Thach That, visitors travel about 10km to Tay Phuong pagoda, which is famous for making bamboo dragonflies, and the dragonflies are sold right at the souvenir stalls in Tay Phuong pagoda.

Bamboo bean craft in Dinh Cong

The craft village is located right in the capital of Hanoi, if you have the opportunity to travel to Hanoi, visitors should set foot in Dinh Cong and visit the traditional craft village, and meet the artisans of the craft village.

Silver-making means that when the silver has been melted, skilled craftsmen will pull the silver into the shapes of flowers, leaves, birds or jewelry with main products such as: bracelets, lapel pins, rings, earrings, pendants, necklaces, silver souvenirs… when you come here you can buy them as gifts.

Chuong conical hat village

Located in Thanh Oai, Hanoi, when you come here, visit the market held on even days, on the 4th, 10th, 14th, 20th, 24th and 30th of the lunar month, the market usually opens from 6am to 8am, the market specializes in selling hats and hat-making materials.

It can be said that Chuong Village’s conical hats have long been famous for their durability and beauty. If you visit Chuong Village, you can buy them as souvenirs, or visit the village to learn how to make hats with the artisans in the village. You will make hats from the basics to the finished product, and you can draw patterns on the hats yourself and then bring them home as gifts.

Ha Thai Lacquer Village

Located in Thuong Tin, Hanoi. The craft village has long been famous for its unique lacquer products such as vases, bowls, plates, chopsticks… and unique and sophisticated wall decorations. Currently, Ha Thai lacquer paintings have spread to other countries, the paintings exude the beauty of Vietnamese countryside.

Chang Son Fan Village

Located in Thach That, Hanoi, the products have been exported to many countries, every day hundreds of fans of many types are produced such as: paper fans, bamboo fans, silk fans, picture fans…

Bat Trang Pottery Village

The craft village specializes in producing teapots, bowls, plates, and vases made of ceramic. There are also construction materials and insulating porcelain. Coming here, visitors can visit the season of ceramic products as gifts, and mold the products with their own hands with long-time artisans in the profession. Many foreign tourists when going on a tour Vietnam visit Bat Trang Pottery Village, to experience and admire the scenery of the traditional craft village in Vietnam.

Canh Hoach Bird Cage Village

Located in Vac Street, Thanh Oai and 30km southwest of Hanoi center, Vac Village was formerly known as Canh Village, a place famous for making products such as: Fans, hats, especially bird cages, many people who raise ornamental birds often choose to buy bird cages here. Especially when visiting the craft village, tourists also buy typical products here as souvenirs.

So above are the Vietnamese craft villages in the suburbs of Hanoi, for any tourist when choosing to visit craft villages in the suburbs of Hanoi, they cannot ignore the traditional craft villages, coming here visitors will encounter a peaceful scene, exuding the rustic beauty of a Vietnamese village.
